# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `ppj-venture-labs` MCP server pointing at Kalender Sync's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://app.kalender-sync.de/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth with a Kalender Sync account.
- Logo: Kalender Sync's calendar mark from the `kalender-sync` GitHub organization avatar.
